# Replica Diff, score how close your clone is to the original

Curated by Skill Harbor: the comparison step of the 11-skill Replica pack. Replica Diff answers how close your clone really is: a weighted feature parity score from your feature matrix, with the missing list in build order, a screenshot layout diff that ignores colour so a rebrand does not count against you, and a behaviour diff walked flow by flow. The report ends with an honest verdict: not shippable if any must-have is missing or an S1 bug is open, shippable when the must-haves are done and the feature score reaches 80 (the --visual overall score is a different number: 80% features + 20% layout), or better than the original when the entrepreneur fixes are in too. By @Jakeschincariol, listed here with credit to its creator. Skill Harbor never reviews the code of a listed skill, so review it yourself before use.
